title: Nonnegativity of the $g$-polynomial of split matroids
summary: We prove that the $g$-polynomial of every split matroid has nonnegative coefficients, establishing Speyer's conjecture for a class closed under taking minors and containing all paving and copaving matroids. Our proof uses a deletion--contraction identity obtained by constructing an auxiliary split matroid. We first show that every simple, cosimple, connected split matroid $M$ has an element $e$ for which both the deletion $M\setminus e$ and the contraction $M/e$ are connected.
